rules: War leaves persistent consequences even after peace.
Veteran/background hooks require actual service/conflict participation.
Destroyed infrastructure remains destroyed/damaged until repaired/rebuilt.
Territorial settlements must update Block 2 claim/control/border state explicitly.
Reparations/economic burdens can emit Block 4 inputs but Block 3 does not model the full economy.
Post-conflict resentment/reconciliation are stateful processes, not automatic mood resets.
